title: Keyboard input
summary: Samples generic namespaced actions from a keyboard; preserves the existing flight keyboard/hold-button adapter.

blocks.text: Samples generic namespaced actions from a keyboard; preserves the existing flight keyboard/hold-button adapter.
Capabilities: input.keyboard@1.0.0; no required or optional services. Constructors receive active actions and seat assignment.
Environment: browser and offline. Platform authority; excluded from authoritative simulation identity. Public API and local source only.

Generic sources have no persistence. The flight adapter receives bindings from its caller. All DOM listeners and held input are released on disposal; blur, hidden/pagehide, capture suppression and reassignment clear held generic input.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild and repack. Explicitly enable trusted code in a compatible game; imported code has full application privileges. Package-building success alone does not establish game/runtime portability.

The optional legacy adapter controlShortcut(code) port allows selected resolved shortcuts while a button, summary or link has focus. Text fields, selects and editable content keep suppressing gameplay shortcuts. The flight host uses this for explicit warp commands so pilot time control can cancel a conflicting automatic approach.
